physical.scanNote: No copyright page found. No table-of-contents pages found. (Note: a TOC does exist in the images; OCR just failed on it.)

ocrEvidence.rootCause: Tesseract ran with Latin (plus jav/que/ltz) models only; no Armenian traineddata, so the whole book OCR'd as Latin transliteration garbage. Representative across the entire file, not a preview quirk.

fallback.title: Armenian Bible (Ararat) - Gospel of Mark
fallback.verdict: Worth caching as a small Eastern-Armenian dialect reference (it has real Armenian-script OCR, unlike the main item), but Mark-only so NOT an import candidate.

decision: Does not pass the gate: OCR text is unusable and the dialect is Western (not Eastern). Stopped; no data/ or app.js changes.

hyeReocr.model: tesseract 5.4.0 + tessdata_best hye.traineddata (6,372,242 B), --tessdata-dir build/sources/arm-eastern-1800s/tessdata, -l hye
hyeReocr.method: pdftoppm -r 300 -gray, crop page margins (x 12%-88%, y 3%-97%) to drop the cross-reference margin columns, then tesseract --psm 3. Page-level PSM 1/3 without the crop fail (margin/column confusion); PSM 4 without crop captures text but jumbles reading order across the two columns.
hyeReocr.note: Sample only (front matter + Genesis 1-2 start, Exodus, Psalms 22-23/24-25/119, John 2-3/18, etc.). A full 1168-page pass was NOT run: pdftoppm renders this JP2 PDF at ~9 s/page, so full render alone is ~3 h, plus ~1.7 h OCR.
hyeReocr.verdict: Armenian script and reading order now correct, but ~80% character agreement with the page-image transcriptions and occasional whole-word corruption of key terms (e.g. Ps 23:1 'հովիւ'->'Գովեա', Gen 1:1 'ՍԿԻԶԲՆ'->'Հ4եգուն', Jn 3:16 'այնքան'->'անանկ'). Readable, not import-grade without correction.
